8) $FTNT - Fortinet

The network still has to exist. $2.05 billion quarter, up 26%. Product revenue $773 million, up from $509 million a year ago. $606 million of net income. Raised the year to 19% growth. The market treats them like a leftover firewall vendor. AI data centers and agent traffic still hit a box at the edge, and Fortinet owns a lot of those boxes.
